name: clearjev-router
description: Intelligent model routing layer for Codex: Jev (TypeSafe System One) judges every prompt before execution and injects model/reasoning/planning guidance.

interface.longDescription: ClearJev adds a pre-prompt Jev judgment layer to Codex. A UserPromptSubmit hook classifies intent, complexity, risk and repository demand via TypeSafe Jev, then injects a concise routing decision (model, reasoning, planning, validation) as developer context. Code owns the workflow; Jev supplies typed judgments.
defaultPrompt: Route this task with ClearJev before implementing.
Explain the ClearJev routing decision for my last prompt.
